info.title: EXENDE JOBS INTELLIGENCE
info.description: Structured hiring intelligence for AI agents. Pay per request with x402. These deployed routes extend the existing api.exende.dev service. All seven routes passed live unpaid challenges, free CDP discovery validation, real paid response/schema checks and on-chain USDC settlement checks on 2026-10-19. A repeated settled payment was rejected with HTTP 409. Eight-endpoint marketplace visibility remains pending.

servers.description: Production Exende service; Jobs paid responses, on-chain settlement and replay rejection verified on 2026-10-19.

tags.name: Jobs Intelligence
tags.description: Structured hiring intelligence for AI agents. Pay per request with x402; no API keys or subscriptions required for individual x402 requests.

get.description: Search up to 10 observed jobs by keyword, location, company, work mode, and employment type. Costs $0.02 USDC per request. Supports x402 v2 exact USDC on Base through EIP-3009 payload.authorization; other payment representations are rejected before upstream access or settlement. All observations describe the Exende monitored catalogue, not the global labour market. Unknown or duplicate query parameters are rejected; no cursor or offset pagination. Inputs are validated before payment.

x-x402.recipient_source: Existing Exende PAY_TO; the current PAYMENT-REQUIRED response is authoritative.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive text filter; at most eight terms.

parameters.description: Source location text; at most eight terms. Not a normalized city.

methodology.current_jobs: status=active; aggregates operate on at most 10000 indexed recent active jobs, scoped to the company when specified
methodology.period: Rolling seven-day UTC interval; current statistics describe the current catalogue.
methodology.remote_false: Only on_site jobs; hybrid and unknown are excluded.

limitations: Synthetic documentation example generated from a local test fixture; not live hiring data.
Statistics cover the Exende monitored catalogue, not the global labour market.
Missing fields and unclassified workplace types are not inferred.
Last observed timestamps may be coalesced to one observation per UTC day; they are not fetch timestamps.
Current skill associations are deterministic title/description extractions, not a complete or historical skill census.
A job no longer observed does not prove a hire. Collection gaps and source coverage can affect observations.

PaymentSignature.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
PaymentSignature.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 signed payment authorization. OpenAPI represents this custom header with the apiKey security-scheme type; it is a per-request payment proof, not an API key, account or subscription. Omit it for an unpaid 402 challenge, then use an x402 client to authorize and retry the same request.
